title: Personal Checking: when an overdraft protection transfer is actually made from the linked savings account
content:
## Scope

This rule governs the overdraft protection transfer itself on a Personal Checking account with a linked savings account: whether a transfer is made when a debit would take the checking ledger balance below zero. It applies to every such transfer, outside the two bank-error refund reviews that judge, after the event, whether an overdraft item fee or an extended overdraft fee should have been avoided by a transfer.

## Formal clause

Outside the refund decisions of the overdraft item fee review and the extended overdraft fee review, an overdraft protection transfer is made only if the savings account's current balance at that moment covers the whole shortfall, and a partial transfer is never made.

## Decision table

| Savings current balance at the moment the debit would overdraw, compared with the whole shortfall | Transfer |
|---|---|
| At least the whole shortfall | Made, for the whole shortfall |
| Less than the whole shortfall | Not made; no partial transfer |

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

- A debit leaves a shortfall of 70.00 USD and the linked savings account holds 250.00 USD at that moment. The balance covers the whole shortfall, so a transfer of 70.00 USD is made.
- The same shortfall of 70.00 USD with 70.00 USD in the linked savings account: the balance covers the whole shortfall exactly, so the transfer is made.
- The same shortfall with 45.00 USD in the linked savings account: the balance does not cover the whole shortfall, so no transfer is made; a transfer of 45.00 USD is not made either.

## Points of judgement

- **Wrong reading:** "the savings account sends whatever it holds when it cannot cover the full shortfall". **Correct basis:** a partial transfer is never made.
- **Wrong reading:** "a live transfer is judged on the savings balance on the day the question is later raised". **Correct basis:** a live transfer is judged on the savings balance at the moment the debit would overdraw the account.
